senses.definition_en: to requisition, commandeer, seize

examples.english: The Generales […] went to the Royal Palace of Aranjuez, from whence they set out for the plains of La Mancha, always at the front, recruiting young men, seizing cavalry, and […] calling for as much funding from the towns' subordinate administration...

examples.text: Los Generales[…]se fueron al Real Sitio de Aranjuez, y de allí enfilaron las planicies manchegas, adelante siempre, reclutando mozos, requisando caballerías, y requiriendo […]cuantos fondos guardaban las administraciones subalternas de los pueblos...
examples.translation: The Generales […] went to the Royal Palace of Aranjuez, from whence they set out for the plains of La Mancha, always at the front, recruiting young men, seizing cavalry, and […] calling for as much funding from the towns' subordinate administration...
